feature: Endpoint officer alternatif /furnish/officer/{list,detail,approve,reject} dengan working days pending, tidak dipanggil UI
story: OCMS41.9, OCMS41.10 (di luar chunk ini; komentar code menyebut OCMS 41.9-41.14)
note: Implementasi kedua untuk list, detail, approve, dan reject yang dilengkapi workingDaysPending dan flag kirim email/SMS. grep 'furnish/officer' di ocmsadminui/src dan api-authorization.properties tidak menemukan apa pun, sedangkan UI memakai furnishapplicationlist dan manual-review/*. Kemungkinan code lama yang tidak dipakai; jangan dihitung sebagai bukti fitur.
note_en: A second implementation of list, detail, approve and reject, with workingDaysPending and email/SMS send flags. grep for 'furnish/officer' in ocmsadminui/src and api-authorization.properties finds nothing, while the UI uses furnishapplicationlist and manual-review/*. Probably unused old code; do not count it as evidence of the feature.

feature: Flag resubmission (Y/N) pada daftar furnish dan badge 'Resubmission' di layar review
story: Tidak jelas (kemungkinan story furnish epic 41 lain)
note: Backend menandai submission sebagai resubmission bila ada submission lebih awal untuk notice_no + owner_id_no yang sama, dan UI menampilkan badge kuning 'Resubmission'. Tidak disebut di OCMS41.11 sampai 41.15.
note_en: The backend marks a submission as a resubmission when an earlier submission exists for the same notice_no + owner_id_no, and the UI shows a yellow 'Resubmission' badge. It is not mentioned in OCMS41.11 to 41.15.
